name: Create Grassland Food Web Flipchart
description:
Create a 3-page science lesson flipchart about a grassland ecosystem food web.

Page 1 - Introduction: Title 'Grassland Food Web' and text defining 'Producer', 'Consumer', and 'Decomposer'.

Page 2 - Food Web Diagram: Create a diagram with at least 6 organisms: Grass, Grasshopper, Frog, Snake, Hawk, and Fungi. Connect them with at least 5 directional arrows showing energy flow (e.g., arrows pointing from prey to predator).

Page 3 - Energy Pyramid: Title 'Energy Pyramid' and draw a pyramid structure using at least 3 stacked shapes. Label the levels: 'Producers', 'Primary Consumers', and 'Secondary Consumers'.

Save the file to: /home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/grassland_food_web.flipchart
